"""Dispatch, candidate selection, route merging, race conditions, cancellation."""
from .client import Client
from .fixtures import setup_basics, register_rider, place_order


def _full_to_preparing(c, ids):
    """Place + accept + start-preparing. Returns oid."""
    _, body = place_order(c, ids)
    oid = body["data"]["id"]
    c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
    c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/start-preparing", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
    return oid


def run(suite):
    def start_preparing_creates_offer():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider_id = register_rider(c)
        oid = _full_to_preparing(c, ids)
        # Find the assignment created by start-preparing
        s, lst = c.get(f"/api/orders?status=PREPARING", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert s == 200
        # We need at least one assignment in OFFERED for the order; pull it via list-by-rider.
        s, body = c.get("/api/assignments/" + _find_assignment_id(c, oid),
                        role="Rider", user_id=rider_id)
        a = body["data"]
        assert a["status"] == "OFFERED"
        assert a["order_id"] == oid

    def order_already_assigned():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider1 = register_rider(c, phone="r1")
        rider2 = register_rider(c, phone="r2")
        oid = _full_to_preparing(c, ids)
        aid = _find_assignment_id(c, oid)
        # accept once
        s, body = c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/accept",
                         role="Rider", user_id=_assignment_rider(c, aid))
        assert s == 200
        # The other rider — dispatch again should refuse since there's already an ACCEPTED assignment
        # Try to create a second OFFERED for the same order via dispatch — PRD says /dispatch always
        # creates a new OFFERED. So new offer exists; then second accept must hit
        # ERR_ORDER_ALREADY_ASSIGNED.
        s, body = c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/dispatch",
                         role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        # Pool may be empty (other rider may not pass merge constraint). Should still produce assignment if pool non-empty.
        if s == 201:
            new_aid = body["data"]["id"]
            new_rider = body["data"]["rider_id"]
            s2, body2 = c.post(f"/api/assignments/{new_aid}/accept",
                                role="Rider", user_id=new_rider)
            assert s2 == 409 and body2["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_ORDER_ALREADY_ASSIGNED"

    def reject_redispatches():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider1 = register_rider(c, phone="r1")
        rider2 = register_rider(c, phone="r2")
        oid = _full_to_preparing(c, ids)
        aid = _find_assignment_id(c, oid)
        rider_a = _assignment_rider(c, aid)
        s, body = c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/reject",
                         role="Rider", user_id=rider_a)
        assert s == 200 and body["data"]["status"] == "REJECTED"
        # A new OFFERED assignment should exist for the order targeting the other rider
        new_aid = _find_assignment_id(c, oid)
        assert new_aid != aid

    def cancel_after_accept_creates_fine_and_redispatches():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider1 = register_rider(c, phone="r1")
        rider2 = register_rider(c, phone="r2")  # so redispatch has a candidate
        oid = _full_to_preparing(c, ids)
        aid = _find_assignment_id(c, oid)
        rider_a = _assignment_rider(c, aid)
        # Accept then cancel
        c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/accept", role="Rider", user_id=rider_a)
        s, body = c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/cancel", role="Rider", user_id=rider_a)
        assert s == 200 and body["data"]["status"] == "CANCELLED"
        # Rider's wallet should be -500c (RIDER_NO_SHOW)
        s, r_body = c.get(f"/api/riders/{rider_a}", role="Rider", user_id=rider_a)
        assert r_body["data"]["wallet_balance_cents"] == -500
        # There should now be a fresh OFFERED to the other rider
        new_aid = _find_assignment_id(c, oid)
        assert new_aid != aid

    def dispatch_with_empty_pool_invalid_state():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        # No riders registered -> /start-preparing should still succeed because dispatch failure
        # at start-preparing is swallowed. But /dispatch should ERR_INVALID_STATE.
        _, body = place_order(c, ids)
        oid = body["data"]["id"]
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/start-preparing", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        s, e = c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/dispatch",
                      role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert s == 409 and e["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_INVALID_STATE"

    suite.case("start-preparing creates OFFERED assignment", start_preparing_creates_offer)
    suite.case("second accept on same order -> ERR_ORDER_ALREADY_ASSIGNED", order_already_assigned)
    suite.case("rider reject -> REJECTED + redispatch", reject_redispatches)
    suite.case("rider cancel after accept -> RIDER_NO_SHOW fine + wallet debit + redispatch",
               cancel_after_accept_creates_fine_and_redispatches)
    suite.case("/dispatch with empty pool -> ERR_INVALID_STATE", dispatch_with_empty_pool_invalid_state)


def _find_assignment_id(c, oid):
    """Find an OFFERED/ACCEPTED/PICKED_UP assignment for the order."""
    from app.server import store
    for a in store.assignments.values():
        if a["order_id"] == oid and a["status"] in ("OFFERED", "ACCEPTED", "PICKED_UP"):
            return a["id"]
    raise AssertionError(f"no live assignment for order {oid}")


def _assignment_rider(c, aid):
    from app.server import store
    return store.assignments[aid]["rider_id"]

        s, lst = c.get(f"/api/orders?status=PREPARING", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert s == 200
        # We need at least one assignment in OFFERED for the order; pull it via list-by-rider.
        s, body = c.get("/api/assignments/" + _find_assignment_id(c, oid),
                        role="Rider", user_id=rider_id)
        a = body["data"]
        assert a["status"] == "OFFERED"
        assert a["order_id"] == oid

    def order_already_assigned():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider1 = register_rider(c, phone="r1")
        rider2 = register_rider(c, phone="r2")
        oid = _full_to_preparing(c, ids)
        aid = _find_assignment_id(c, oid)
        # accept once
        s, body = c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/accept",
                         role="Rider", user_id=_assignment_rider(c, aid))
        assert s == 200
        # The other rider — dispatch again should refuse since there's already an ACCEPTED assignment
        # Try to create a second OFFERED for the same order via dispatch — PRD says /dispatch always
        # creates a new OFFERED. So new offer exists; then second accept must hit
        # ERR_ORDER_ALREADY_ASSIGNED.
        s, body = c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/dispatch",
                         role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        # Pool may be empty (other rider may not pass merge constraint). Should still produce assignment if pool non-empty.
        if s == 201:
            new_aid = body["data"]["id"]
            new_rider = body["data"]["rider_id"]
            s2, body2 = c.post(f"/api/assignments/{new_aid}/accept",
                                role="Rider", user_id=new_rider)
            assert s2 == 409 and body2["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_ORDER_ALREADY_ASSIGNED"

    def reject_redispatches():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider1 = register_rider(c, phone="r1")
        rider2 = register_rider(c, phone="r2")
        oid = _full_to_preparing(c, ids)
        aid = _find_assignment_id(c, oid)
        rider_a = _assignment_rider(c, aid)
        s, body = c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/reject",
                         role="Rider", user_id=rider_a)
        assert s == 200 and body["data"]["status"] == "REJECTED"
        # A new OFFERED assignment should exist for the order targeting the other rider
        new_aid = _find_assignment_id(c, oid)
        assert new_aid != aid

    def cancel_after_accept_creates_fine_and_redispatches():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider1 = register_rider(c, phone="r1")
        rider2 = register_rider(c, phone="r2")  # so redispatch has a candidate
        oid = _full_to_preparing(c, ids)
        aid = _find_assignment_id(c, oid)
        rider_a = _assignment_rider(c, aid)
        # Accept then cancel
        c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/accept", role="Rider", user_id=rider_a)
        s, body = c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/cancel", role="Rider", user_id=rider_a)
        assert s == 200 and body["data"]["status"] == "CANCELLED"
        # Rider's wallet should be -500c (RIDER_NO_SHOW)
        s, r_body = c.get(f"/api/riders/{rider_a}", role="Rider", user_id=rider_a)
        assert r_body["data"]["wallet_balance_cents"] == -500
        # There should now be a fresh OFFERED to the other rider
        new_aid = _find_assignment_id(c, oid)
        assert new_aid != aid

    def dispatch_with_empty_pool_invalid_state():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        # No riders registered -> /start-preparing should still succeed because dispatch failure
        # at start-preparing is swallowed. But /dispatch should ERR_INVALID_STATE.
        _, body = place_order(c, ids)
        oid = body["data"]["id"]
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/start-preparing", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        s, e = c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/dispatch",
                      role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert s == 409 and e["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_INVALID_STATE"

    suite.case("start-preparing creates OFFERED assignment", start_preparing_creates_offer)
    suite.case("second accept on same order -> ERR_ORDER_ALREADY_ASSIGNED", order_already_assigned)
    suite.case("rider reject -> REJECTED + redispatch", reject_redispatches)
    suite.case("rider cancel after accept -> RIDER_NO_SHOW fine + wallet debit + redispatch",
               cancel_after_accept_creates_fine_and_redispatches)
    suite.case("/dispatch with empty pool -> ERR_INVALID_STATE", dispatch_with_empty_pool_invalid_state)


def _find_assignment_id(c, oid):
    """Find an OFFERED/ACCEPTED/PICKED_UP assignment for the order."""
    from app.server import store
    for a in store.assignments.values():
        if a["order_id"] == oid and a["status"] in ("OFFERED", "ACCEPTED", "PICKED_UP"):
            return a["id"]
    raise AssertionError(f"no live assignment for order {oid}")


def _assignment_rider(c, aid):
    from app.server import store
    return store.assignments[aid]["rider_id"]

"""Delivery cascade: late fine, commission reconciliation, settlement, wallet, route group."""
from .client import Client
from .fixtures import setup_basics, register_rider, place_order


def _drive_to_pickup(c, ids):
    rider = register_rider(c)
    _, body = place_order(c, ids)
    oid = body["data"]["id"]
    c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
    c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/start-preparing", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
    from app.server import store
    aid = next(a["id"] for a in store.assignments.values() if a["order_id"] == oid and a["status"] == "OFFERED")
    c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/accept", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
    c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/ready", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
    c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/pickup", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
    return rider, oid, aid


def run(suite):
    def on_time_delivery_cascade():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider, oid, aid = _drive_to_pickup(c, ids)
        # Deliver immediately (well before 45 min) -> minutes_late=0
        s, body = c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/deliver", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
        assert s == 200
        # Order
        s, o_body = c.get(f"/api/orders/{oid}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        o = o_body["data"]
        assert o["status"] == "DELIVERED"
        assert o["payment_status"] == "CAPTURED"
        assert o["minutes_late"] == 0
        assert o["actual_delivery_time"] is not None
        # Final fee == solo fee for a single-leg delivery
        assert o["final_delivery_fee_cents"] is not None
        assert o["final_commission_cents"] is not None
        # Restaurant settlement = subtotal - final_commission
        s, r_body = c.get(f"/api/restaurants/{ids['rid']}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert r_body["data"]["pending_settlement_cents"] == o["subtotal_cents"] - o["final_commission_cents"]
        # Rider wallet credited
        s, r2 = c.get(f"/api/riders/{rider}", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
        assert r2["data"]["wallet_balance_cents"] == o["final_delivery_fee_cents"]
        # Rider returned to AVAILABLE (no other assignments)
        assert r2["data"]["status"] == "AVAILABLE"

    def commission_uses_override_at_delivery():
        c, ids = setup_basics(rate_override=0.10)
        rider, oid, aid = _drive_to_pickup(c, ids)
        c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/deliver", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
        s, o = c.get(f"/api/orders/{oid}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        # subtotal 500c -> override 0.10 -> 50c
        assert o["data"]["final_commission_cents"] == 50

    def late_delivery_creates_fine():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider, oid, aid = _drive_to_pickup(c, ids)
        # Advance clock past promised time by 50 minutes (45-min promise + 5 min lateness)
        c.post("/api/_clock/advance", {"seconds": 50 * 60},
               role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        s, _ = c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/deliver", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
        assert s == 200
        s, o = c.get(f"/api/orders/{oid}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert o["data"]["minutes_late"] == 5
        # Fine of 200c
        s, fines = c.get("/api/fines", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
        late_fines = [f for f in fines["data"] if f["reason"] == "LATE_DELIVERY"]
        assert len(late_fines) == 1
        assert late_fines[0]["amount_cents"] == 200
        # Wallet: +final_fee then -200
        s, r = c.get(f"/api/riders/{rider}", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
        assert r["data"]["wallet_balance_cents"] == o["data"]["final_delivery_fee_cents"] - 200

    def very_late_delivery_uses_clawback_cap():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider, oid, aid = _drive_to_pickup(c, ids)
        # Advance > 30 min late: 45 min promise + 31 min late = 76 min
        c.post("/api/_clock/advance", {"seconds": 76 * 60},
               role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/deliver", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
        s, fines = c.get("/api/fines", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
        late_fines = [f for f in fines["data"] if f["reason"] == "LATE_DELIVERY"]
        assert len(late_fines) == 1
        # fee for ~1.5km distance => 300 + 2*120 = 540 (no peak) -> capped at 540, plus 500
        # Since exact fee depends on the configured coordinates, just check the formula structure:
        s, o = c.get(f"/api/orders/{oid}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        fee = o["data"]["final_delivery_fee_cents"]
        expected = min(fee, 1500) + 500
        assert late_fines[0]["amount_cents"] == expected

    def deliver_requires_picked_up_status():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider = register_rider(c)
        _, body = place_order(c, ids)
        oid = body["data"]["id"]
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/start-preparing", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        from app.server import store
        aid = next(a["id"] for a in store.assignments.values()
                   if a["order_id"] == oid and a["status"] == "OFFERED")
        c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/accept", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
        # Skip pickup -> deliver should ERR_INVALID_STATE
        s, _ = c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/deliver", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
        assert s == 409

    suite.case("on-time delivery cascade: settlement + wallet + AVAILABLE", on_time_delivery_cascade)
    suite.case("commission override applied at delivery", commission_uses_override_at_delivery)
    suite.case("late delivery -> LATE_DELIVERY fine + wallet net effect", late_delivery_creates_fine)
    suite.case(">30min late uses min(fee, 1500) + 500 clawback", very_late_delivery_uses_clawback_cap)
    suite.case("deliver requires PICKED_UP", deliver_requires_picked_up_status)

    c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/deliver", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
    return rider, oid


def run(suite):
    def open_and_approve_full_refund():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider, oid = _to_delivered(c, ids)
        # Open return for full subtotal
        s, body = c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/returns",
                         {"reason": "WRONG_ITEM", "requested_refund_cents": 500},
                         role="Customer", user_id=ids["cid"])
        assert s == 201
        ret_id = body["data"]["id"]
        # Order should be REFUND_REQUESTED
        s, o = c.get(f"/api/orders/{oid}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert o["data"]["status"] == "REFUND_REQUESTED"
        # Approve for full subtotal
        s, body = c.post(f"/api/returns/{ret_id}/approve",
                         {"approved_refund_cents": 500},
                         role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-1")
        assert s == 200 and body["data"]["status"] == "APPROVED"
        assert body["data"]["reviewer_cs_user_id"] == "cs-1"
        s, o = c.get(f"/api/orders/{oid}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert o["data"]["status"] == "REFUNDED"
        assert o["data"]["payment_status"] == "FULLY_REFUNDED"
        # Customer credit credited
        s, cust = c.get(f"/api/customers/{ids['cid']}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert cust["data"]["credit_balance_cents"] == 500

    def partial_refund_partial_status():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider, oid = _to_delivered(c, ids)
        _, body = c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/returns",
                         {"reason": "QUALITY_ISSUE", "requested_refund_cents": 300},
                         role="Customer", user_id=ids["cid"])
        ret_id = body["data"]["id"]
        s, body = c.post(f"/api/returns/{ret_id}/approve",
                         {"approved_refund_cents": 300},
                         role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-1")
        s, o = c.get(f"/api/orders/{oid}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert o["data"]["payment_status"] == "PARTIALLY_REFUNDED"

    def duplicate_return_rejected():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider, oid = _to_delivered(c, ids)
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/returns",
               {"reason": "WRONG_ITEM", "requested_refund_cents": 100},
               role="Customer", user_id=ids["cid"])
        s, e = c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/returns",
                      {"reason": "WRONG_ITEM", "requested_refund_cents": 100},
                      role="Customer", user_id=ids["cid"])
        assert s == 409 and e["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_DUPLICATE_RETURN"

    def return_window_expired():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider, oid = _to_delivered(c, ids)
        # Advance >24h
        c.post("/api/_clock/advance", {"seconds": 25 * 3600},
               role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        s, e = c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/returns",
                      {"reason": "OTHER", "requested_refund_cents": 100},
                      role="Customer", user_id=ids["cid"])
        assert s == 422 and e["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_RETURN_WINDOW_EXPIRED"

    def refund_amount_invalid():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider, oid = _to_delivered(c, ids)
        s, e = c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/returns",
                      {"reason": "OTHER", "requested_refund_cents": 0},
                      role="Customer", user_id=ids["cid"])
        assert s == 422 and e["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID"
        s, e = c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/returns",
                      {"reason": "OTHER", "requested_refund_cents": 10_000},  # > subtotal
                      role="Customer", user_id=ids["cid"])
        assert s == 422 and e["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID"

    def approve_amount_over_requested_invalid():

"""Return / refund flow."""
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from flask import request, g

from ..auth import parse_headers, require_role
from ..clock import format_iso
from ..envelope import success
from ..errors import fail
from ..ids import new_uuid
from ..resource import stamp_new, bump
from ..server import store, clock


REASONS = {"QUALITY_ISSUE", "WRONG_ITEM", "LATE", "OTHER"}


def _parse_iso(s: str) -> datetime:
    if s.endswith("Z"):
        s = s[:-1] + "+00:00"
    return datetime.fromisoformat(s)


def open_return(oid):
    user_id, role = parse_headers()
    require_role("Customer")
    o = store.orders.get(oid)
    if not o:
        raise fail("ERR_NOT_FOUND")
    if user_id != o["customer_id"]:
        raise fail("ERR_FORBIDDEN")
    if o["status"] not in ("DELIVERED",):
        raise fail("ERR_INVALID_STATE")
    # Duplicate return check (before window / amount):
    for r in store.returns.values():
        if r["order_id"] == oid and r["status"] in ("REQUESTED", "APPROVED", "ESCALATED"):
            raise fail("ERR_DUPLICATE_RETURN")
    # 24-hour window
    actual = _parse_iso(o["actual_delivery_time"])
    if (clock.now() - actual) > timedelta(hours=24):
        raise fail("ERR_RETURN_WINDOW_EXPIRED")
    body = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
    reason = body.get("reason")
    if reason not in REASONS:
        raise fail("ERR_VALIDATION", "reason invalid")
    requested = body.get("requested_refund_cents")
    if not isinstance(requested, int) or isinstance(requested, bool):
        raise fail("ERR_REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID")
    if requested < 1 or requested > o["subtotal_cents"]:
        raise fail("ERR_REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID")
    rec = stamp_new()
    rec.update({
        "order_id": oid,
        "reason": reason,
        "requested_refund_cents": requested,
        "approved_refund_cents": None,
        "reviewer_cs_user_id": None,
        "status": "REQUESTED",
    })
    store.returns[rec["id"]] = rec
    # Order cascade
    o["status"] = "REFUND_REQUESTED"
    bump(o)
    return success(rec, status=201)


def approve_return(rid):
    user_id, role = parse_headers()
    require_role("CustomerService")
    ret = store.returns.get(rid)
    if not ret:
        raise fail("ERR_NOT_FOUND")
    if ret["status"] not in ("REQUESTED", "ESCALATED"):
        raise fail("ERR_INVALID_STATE")
    o = store.orders[ret["order_id"]]
    body = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
    approved = body.get("approved_refund_cents")
    if not isinstance(approved, int) or isinstance(approved, bool):
        raise fail("ERR_REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID")
    if approved < 1 or approved > o["subtotal_cents"] or approved > ret["requested_refund_cents"]:
        raise fail("ERR_REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID")
    # Apply cascade
    ret["status"] = "APPROVED"
    ret["approved_refund_cents"] = approved
    ret["reviewer_cs_user_id"] = user_id
    bump(ret)
    # Order
    o["status"] = "REFUNDED"
    o["payment_status"] = "FULLY_REFUNDED" if approved == o["subtotal_cents"] else "PARTIALLY_REFUNDED"
    bump(o)
    # Customer credit
    customer = store.customers[o["customer_id"]]
    customer["credit_balance_cents"] += approved
    # Trust score: a successful return uses up some trust. PRD says it drops on abusive returns —
    # only fine creation drops the customer's trust on QUALITY_ISSUE + low trust; we keep this here
    # as a no-op for non-abusive returns.
    bump(customer)
    # Restaurant settlement decrement
    restaurant = store.restaurants[o["restaurant_id"]]
    restaurant["pending_settlement_cents"] -= approved
    bump(restaurant)
    # Abusive return fine
    if customer["trust_score"] < 0.5 and ret["reason"] == "QUALITY_ISSUE":
        from .fines import create_fine
        create_fine("CUSTOMER", customer["id"], "ABUSIVE_RETURN", approved)
    # Close any linked work order(s) that target this return — not specified, leave open.
    return success(ret)


def reject_return(rid):
    user_id, role = parse_headers()
    require_role("CustomerService")
    ret = store.returns.get(rid)
    if not ret:
        raise fail("ERR_NOT_FOUND")
    if ret["status"] not in ("REQUESTED", "ESCALATED"):
        raise fail("ERR_INVALID_STATE")
    ret["status"] = "REJECTED"
    ret["reviewer_cs_user_id"] = user_id
    bump(ret)
    # Order reverts from REFUND_REQUESTED to DELIVERED
    o = store.orders[ret["order_id"]]
    if o["status"] == "REFUND_REQUESTED":
        o["status"] = "DELIVERED"
        bump(o)
    return success(ret)


def escalate_return(rid):
    user_id, role = parse_headers()
    require_role("CustomerService")
    ret = store.returns.get(rid)
    if not ret:
        raise fail("ERR_NOT_FOUND")
    if ret["status"] != "REQUESTED":
        raise fail("ERR_INVALID_STATE")
    ret["status"] = "ESCALATED"
    bump(ret)
    # Open a linked WorkOrder
    from ..resource import stamp_new
    wo = stamp_new()
    wo.update({
        "opened_by_role": "CUSTOMER_SERVICE",
        "opened_by_id": user_id,
        "category": "OTHER",
        "related_order_id": ret["order_id"],
        "related_return_id": ret["id"],
        "status": "OPEN",
        "assigned_cs_user_id": None,
        "resolution_notes": None,
    })
    store.work_orders[wo["id"]] = wo
    return success(ret)


def reopen_return(rid):
    user_id, role = parse_headers()
    require_role("CustomerService")
    ret = store.returns.get(rid)
    if not ret:
        raise fail("ERR_NOT_FOUND")
    if ret["status"] != "ESCALATED":
        raise fail("ERR_INVALID_STATE")
    ret["status"] = "REQUESTED"
    bump(ret)
    # Close linked WorkOrder
    for wo in store.work_orders.values():
        if wo["related_return_id"] == ret["id"] and wo["status"] not in ("RESOLVED", "CLOSED"):
            wo["status"] = "CLOSED"
            bump(wo)
            break
    return success(ret)

from .client import Client
from .fixtures import setup_basics, register_rider, place_order


def _create_no_show_fine(c, ids):
    """Drive an assignment to ACCEPTED then cancel to mint a RIDER_NO_SHOW fine. Returns (rider_id, fine_id)."""
    rider = register_rider(c, phone="r-fines-a")
    # Need a 2nd rider so cancellation's redispatch can still find a candidate (not required)
    register_rider(c, phone="r-fines-b")
    _, body = place_order(c, ids)
    oid = body["data"]["id"]
    c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
    c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/start-preparing", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
    from app.server import store
    aid = next(a["id"] for a in store.assignments.values()
               if a["order_id"] == oid and a["status"] == "OFFERED")
    accepting_rider = store.assignments[aid]["rider_id"]
    c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/accept", role="Rider", user_id=accepting_rider)
    c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/cancel", role="Rider", user_id=accepting_rider)
    fid = next(f["id"] for f in store.fines.values()
               if f["reason"] == "RIDER_NO_SHOW" and f["subject_id"] == accepting_rider)
    return accepting_rider, fid


def run(suite):
    def list_scoped_to_own_for_rider():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        r1, _ = _create_no_show_fine(c, ids)
        # Another fine for a different rider
        c2, ids2 = setup_basics()
        r2, _ = _create_no_show_fine(c2, ids2)
        # r1 must not see r2's fines
        s, body = c.get("/api/fines", role="Rider", user_id=r1)
        assert s == 200
        for f in body["data"]:
            assert f["subject_id"] == r1

    def waive_reverses_wallet_debit():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider, fid = _create_no_show_fine(c, ids)
        s, body = c.get(f"/api/riders/{rider}", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
        wallet_before = body["data"]["wallet_balance_cents"]
        s, body = c.post(f"/api/fines/{fid}/waive",
                         role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-1")
        assert s == 200 and body["data"]["settlement_status"] == "WAIVED"
        s, body = c.get(f"/api/riders/{rider}", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
        assert body["data"]["wallet_balance_cents"] == wallet_before + 500

    def cannot_waive_settled():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider, fid = _create_no_show_fine(c, ids)
        from app.server import store
        store.fines[fid]["settlement_status"] = "SETTLED"
        s, e = c.post(f"/api/fines/{fid}/waive",
                      role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-1")
        assert s == 409

    def rider_cannot_query_other_rider():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider, fid = _create_no_show_fine(c, ids)
        # Try to query with a different rider as the X-User-ID + explicit subject_id pointing at our rider
        s, e = c.get(f"/api/fines?subject_id={rider}",
                     role="Rider", user_id="other-rider")
        assert s == 403

    suite.case("rider sees only own fines on /api/fines", list_scoped_to_own_for_rider)
    suite.case("waive PENDING -> WAIVED + ledger reversed", waive_reverses_wallet_debit)
    suite.case("waive SETTLED -> ERR_INVALID_STATE", cannot_waive_settled)
    suite.case("rider cannot query another rider's fines", rider_cannot_query_other_rider)

"""Clock advance + 60s offer-timeout sweep."""
from .client import Client
from .fixtures import setup_basics, register_rider, place_order


def run(suite):
    def advance_requires_admin():
        c = Client()
        s, _ = c.post("/api/_clock/advance", {"seconds": 1}, role="Customer", user_id="x")
        assert s == 403

    def offer_timeout_sweep():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider = register_rider(c)
        # Place + start-preparing -> assignment OFFERED
        _, body = place_order(c, ids)
        oid = body["data"]["id"]
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/start-preparing", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        from app.server import store
        aid = next(a["id"] for a in store.assignments.values()
                   if a["order_id"] == oid and a["status"] == "OFFERED")
        # Advance > 60s
        s, body = c.post("/api/_clock/advance", {"seconds": 61},
                         role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert s == 200
        assert body["data"]["swept_offers"] >= 1
        # The original assignment should be REJECTED
        s, a = c.get(f"/api/assignments/{aid}",
                     role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert a["data"]["status"] == "REJECTED"
        # A fresh offer should not exist because there's only one rider and they were the candidate
        # for this order. After their rejection, dispatch finds no candidate (same rider still excluded
        # only if it has a live assignment for this order; since the old one is REJECTED, they could
        # be re-offered). PRD says the system never re-offers an order to a rider who already holds it
        # — meaning "still holds" via OFFERED/ACCEPTED/PICKED_UP. REJECTED is not a live holding.
        # So a new OFFERED should exist targeting the same rider.
        new = [a for a in store.assignments.values()
               if a["order_id"] == oid and a["status"] == "OFFERED"]
        assert len(new) == 1

    def advance_below_60s_does_not_sweep():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider = register_rider(c)
        _, body = place_order(c, ids)
        oid = body["data"]["id"]
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/start-preparing", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        s, body = c.post("/api/_clock/advance", {"seconds": 30},
                         role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert body["data"]["swept_offers"] == 0

    suite.case("/api/_clock/advance restricted to PlatformAdmin", advance_requires_admin)
    suite.case("clock advance > 60s sweeps OFFERED -> REJECTED + redispatch", offer_timeout_sweep)
    suite.case("advance < 60s leaves OFFERED alone", advance_below_60s_does_not_sweep)

"""Validation pipeline ordering (§2.6).

Priority:
 1. Auth headers
 2. Role-to-endpoint authorization
 3. Path-parameter existence (left-to-right)
 4. Body foreign-key existence
 5. Entity-identity match
 6. State-machine precondition
 7. Domain-specific safety checks (RESTAURANT_UNAVAILABLE, SUSPEND_CRITERIA_NOT_MET)
 8. Uniqueness invariants
 9. Temporal windows
10. Fiscal amount range
11. Body shape (ERR_VALIDATION / ERR_ORDER_INVALID)
12. OCC
13. Cross-entity gating (RELATED_RETURN_UNRESOLVED)
"""
from .client import Client
from .fixtures import setup_basics, register_rider, place_order


def run(suite):
    def auth_before_anything():
        # POST orders without headers — should yield ERR_AUTH_REQUIRED even though body is bogus.
        c = Client()
        s, body = c.post("/api/orders", {"items": "bogus"})
        assert s == 401 and body["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_AUTH_REQUIRED"

    def role_before_path_existence():
        # Customer tries POST /api/restaurants — even though body is missing, RBAC fires first
        c = Client()
        s, body = c.post("/api/restaurants", {}, role="Customer", user_id="x")
        assert s == 403 and body["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_FORBIDDEN"

    def path_left_to_right():
        # Unknown restaurant id in /api/restaurants/<rid>/menu-items
        c = Client()
        s, body = c.get("/api/restaurants/bogus/menu-items",
                        role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert s == 404 and body["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_NOT_FOUND"

    def body_fk_existence():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        # menu_item_id valid but customer_id bogus
        s, body = c.post("/api/orders", {
            "customer_id": "bogus", "restaurant_id": ids["rid"],
            "items": [{"menu_item_id": ids["mid"], "quantity": 1}],
        }, role="Customer", user_id="bogus")
        # customer_id is checked before role-identity, per pipeline step 4
        assert s == 404

    def identity_before_state_precondition():
        # A non-owner tries to accept an order
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        register_rider(c)
        _, body = place_order(c, ids)
        oid = body["data"]["id"]
        s, body = c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/accept",
                         role="Restaurant", user_id="wrong-restaurant")
        assert s == 403

    def state_before_domain_safety():
        # cancelling a delivered order: state machine should fire before any domain check
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider = register_rider(c)
        _, body = place_order(c, ids)
        oid = body["data"]["id"]
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/start-preparing", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        from app.server import store
        aid = next(a["id"] for a in store.assignments.values() if a["order_id"] == oid)
        c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/accept", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/ready", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/pickup", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
        c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/deliver", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
        # Now try to cancel a DELIVERED order
        s, body = c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/cancel",
                         role="Customer", user_id=ids["cid"])
        assert s == 409 and body["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_INVALID_STATE"

    def occ_after_other_checks():
        # An invalid version is meaningless when role auth fails first.
        c = Client()
        s, body = c.patch("/api/restaurants/bogus", {"version": 1, "address": "a"},
                          role="Customer", user_id="x")
        # Customer not allowed to PATCH /api/restaurants/{id} -> ERR_FORBIDDEN before NOT_FOUND
        assert s == 403

    suite.case("auth fires before any body validation", auth_before_anything)
    suite.case("role auth before path existence", role_before_path_existence)
    suite.case("path id existence checked left-to-right", path_left_to_right)
    suite.case("body foreign-key existence before identity", body_fk_existence)
    suite.case("identity mismatch before state precondition", identity_before_state_precondition)
    suite.case("state precondition before domain check", state_before_domain_safety)
    suite.case("OCC only after other checks pass", occ_after_other_checks)

"""OCC + concurrency-shaped failures."""
from .client import Client
from .fixtures import setup_basics, register_rider, place_order


def run(suite):
    def two_patches_same_version():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rid = ids["rid"]
        # first PATCH @ version=2 (after approve bumped to 2)
        s, body = c.patch(f"/api/restaurants/{rid}", {"address": "first", "version": 2},
                          role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert s == 200
        # second PATCH using stale version=2 -> conflict
        s, e = c.patch(f"/api/restaurants/{rid}", {"address": "second", "version": 2},
                       role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert s == 409 and e["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_VERSION_CONFLICT"

    def two_riders_accept_same_order():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        r1 = register_rider(c, phone="r-x")
        r2 = register_rider(c, phone="r-y")
        _, body = place_order(c, ids)
        oid = body["data"]["id"]
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/start-preparing", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        from app.server import store
        aid_first = next(a["id"] for a in store.assignments.values()
                         if a["order_id"] == oid and a["status"] == "OFFERED")
        # Dispatch a second offer manually
        s, body = c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/dispatch",
                         role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        if s != 201:
            return  # candidate pool exhausted; not the path under test
        aid_second = body["data"]["id"]
        # rider for second offer
        rider_second = body["data"]["rider_id"]
        rider_first = store.assignments[aid_first]["rider_id"]
        # First one accepts
        s, _ = c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid_first}/accept",
                      role="Rider", user_id=rider_first)
        assert s == 200
        # Second one tries to accept -> ERR_ORDER_ALREADY_ASSIGNED
        s, e = c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid_second}/accept",
                      role="Rider", user_id=rider_second)
        assert s == 409 and e["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_ORDER_ALREADY_ASSIGNED"

    suite.case("OCC: stale version PATCH -> ERR_VERSION_CONFLICT", two_patches_same_version)
    suite.case("two riders race to accept -> one wins, other ERR_ORDER_ALREADY_ASSIGNED",
               two_riders_accept_same_order)

"""Pagination defaults, bounds, and ordering by created_at ascending."""
from .client import Client


def run(suite):
    def defaults_and_total():
        c = Client()
        # Create 15 restaurants
        for i in range(15):
            c.post("/api/restaurants",
                   {"name": f"R{i:02d}", "address": "a", "lat": 0, "lng": 0},
                   role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        s, body = c.get("/api/restaurants", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert s == 200
        assert body["meta"]["limit"] == 10
        assert body["meta"]["offset"] == 0
        assert body["meta"]["total_count"] == 15
        assert body["meta"]["has_more"] is True
        assert len(body["data"]) == 10

    def offset_and_window():
        c = Client()
        for i in range(15):
            c.post("/api/restaurants",
                   {"name": f"R{i:02d}", "address": "a", "lat": 0, "lng": 0},
                   role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        s, body = c.get("/api/restaurants?limit=5&offset=12",
                        role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert len(body["data"]) == 3
        assert body["meta"]["has_more"] is False

    def limit_out_of_range():
        c = Client()
        s, body = c.get("/api/restaurants?limit=0",
                        role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert s == 422 and body["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_VALIDATION"
        s, body = c.get("/api/restaurants?limit=101",
                        role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert s == 422

    def sort_by_created_at_ascending():
        c = Client()
        # creation order: A, B, C
        for n in ("A", "B", "C"):
            c.post("/api/restaurants",
                   {"name": n, "address": "a", "lat": 0, "lng": 0},
                   role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        s, body = c.get("/api/restaurants", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        names = [r["name"] for r in body["data"]]
        assert names == ["A", "B", "C"], names

    suite.case("default limit=10, offset=0, total_count, has_more", defaults_and_total)
    suite.case("offset windowing + has_more=false at tail", offset_and_window)
    suite.case("limit out of [1,100] -> ERR_VALIDATION", limit_out_of_range)
    suite.case("default sort by created_at ascending", sort_by_created_at_ascending)

content.text:
The task list is for the implementation work, not this audit, so I won't modify it. I have enough information now to compile the gap audit.

Gap Audit (PRD vs `/app/implementation/`)

---

1. Route merging — group creation gap (HIGH)
- PRD location: §3.6 (paragraph 5 "When the accepting rider already holds an `ACTIVE` `RouteGroup`...").
- Current behavior: `services/dispatch.py:accept_assignment` (lines 169-180) only attaches the new assignment to an *existing* `RouteGroup`. The `else` branch (no active group) is a no-op. A rider's second concurrent assignment that should merge with their first never triggers a merge because the first assignment never produced a `RouteGroup`. Result: route merging is effectively dead code; merged-delivery discount in `services/delivery.py:56` can never fire.
- Recommended fix: when accepting and the rider has another unpicked assignment whose pickup is within 500 m, lazily create a new `RouteGroup` (`status=ACTIVE`, `merged_at=now`, `assignment_ids=[existing_aid, new_aid]`), set `route_group_id` on *both* assignments, and store it in `store.route_groups`. Logic in `_merge_eligible` should be generalized to scan the rider's own unpicked assignments rather than only iterating an existing group.

2. Trust-score evolution (MEDIUM)
- PRD location: §3.2 ("drops on abusive returns and climbs back on good-faith interactions").
- Current behavior: `trust_score` is initialized to 1.0 (`routes/customers.py:50`) and never mutated. Only read in `services/refunds.py:104` for gating the `ABUSIVE_RETURN` fine.
- Recommended fix: on every `Return` that is `APPROVED` with `reason == QUALITY_ISSUE`, decrement `trust_score` (e.g. by 0.1, floor 0.0). On every successful `DELIVERED` order with no return inside the 24-h window, or on rejection of a customer return, increment back toward 1.0 (e.g. +0.05, cap 1.0). PRD does not pin numbers, but some mutation in both directions is required.

3. RouteGroup visibility (LOW — already correct)
- PRD §4 table does not list any `/api/route-groups` endpoint. The implementation correctly omits one. No fix.

4. RESTAURANT_STOCKOUT fines (MEDIUM)
- PRD location: §3.9 enumerates the four `Fine.reason` values including `RESTAURANT_STOCKOUT`; §3.11 references it. No flow in the PRD creates one (no stockout action endpoint exists).
- Current behavior: no code path creates a `RESTAURANT_STOCKOUT` fine.
- Recommended fix: The reason is enumerated but its trigger is undefined by the PRD. Acceptable to leave unused, but the fines waive/list code should still accept it as a valid `subject_type=RESTAURANT` filter value (current code does — it filters by string equality). No code change required; flag for PRD clarification.

5. SETTLED transition (MEDIUM)
- PRD location: §3.9 ("`SETTLED` (when the underlying wallet or settlement event has cleared the balance)").
- Current behavior: `services/fines.py` never sets `SETTLED`; fines stay `PENDING` forever unless waived. The only test that exercises `SETTLED` (`tests/test_fines.py:54`) injects it manually.
- Recommended fix: when a rider fine is created and the resulting `wallet_balance_cents >= 0` after the debit, set the fine to `SETTLED` immediately. For `RESTAURANT` subjects, mark `SETTLED` on `restaurants/{id}/settle` for any `PENDING` fines whose subject is that restaurant. For `CUSTOMER` subjects, mark `SETTLED` once `credit_balance_cents` has absorbed the debit (i.e. when the deduction succeeded without flooring). Without this the `SETTLED` state is unreachable and `waive_fine`'s `PENDING`-only gating is the only meaningful transition.

6. Sort order (already correct)
- All four list endpoints (`restaurants.py:82`, `menu_items.py:62`, `orders.py:184`, `fines.py:70`) sort by `created_at` ascending. No fix.

7. Item validation — `menu_item_id` not found (already correct)
- `routes/orders.py:64-65` raises `ERR_NOT_FOUND` when `menu_item_id` is missing from `store.menu_items`. Matches PRD §2.6 step 4. No fix.

8. Pagination meta on object responses (already correct)
- `envelope.py:_meta` only includes `limit/offset/total_count/has_more` when `page=` is passed; `success(obj)` calls in route files omit `page`, so object responses carry only `api_request_id` and `api_request_timestamp`. No fix.

9. Customer credit floor-at-zero on ABUSIVE_RETURN fine (LOW)
- PRD location: §3.9 / §3.11 — silent on this. §2.9 says `credit_balance_cents` and similar are non-negative integers (§3.2 calls it "a non-negative integer"). 
- Current behavior: `services/fines.py:37` floors at zero.
- Recommended fix: Flooring is correct per §3.2's non-negative invariant. However, this means a fine partially uncollectible from credit leaves no record of the residual — the PRD's "underlying wallet … has cleared the balance" language for `SETTLED` implies tracking. Tie this to item 5: only mark `SETTLED` if the full `amount_cents` was actually debited (not floored).

10. CLOSED restaurant interactions (MEDIUM)
- PRD location: §3.1 ("CLOSED is a terminal lifecycle bucket"). PRD doesn't explicitly say there is a CLOSE endpoint — the endpoint table has only approve/suspend/reinstate/settle. No transition into CLOSED is defined.
- Current behavior: `routes/restaurants.py:172` refuses `/settle` on CLOSED. Nothing else explicitly handles CLOSED. `accept` (orders.py:198) checks `status != ACTIVE` which already excludes CLOSED. Suspension cascade does not apply (CLOSED is unreachable). No fan-out cancellation of PLACED orders on CLOSED transition since there is no transition into CLOSED.
- Recommended fix: None strictly required since the PRD provides no CLOSED-transition path. If desired for completeness, treat CLOSED like SUSPENDED for any inbound order action (it already is because all action paths gate on `ACTIVE`). Flag for PRD clarification on how a restaurant ever reaches CLOSED.

---

Highest-impact action: item 1 (route group creation) and item 5 (`SETTLED` transition). Items 2 and 4 require PRD clarification before implementation.

"""Pagination defaults, bounds, and ordering by created_at ascending."""
from .client import Client


def run(suite):
    def defaults_and_total():
        c = Client()
        # Create 15 restaurants
        for i in range(15):
            c.post("/api/restaurants",
                   {"name": f"R{i:02d}", "address": "a", "lat": 0, "lng": 0},
                   role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        s, body = c.get("/api/restaurants", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert s == 200
        assert body["meta"]["limit"] == 10
        assert body["meta"]["offset"] == 0
        assert body["meta"]["total_count"] == 15
        assert body["meta"]["has_more"] is True
        assert len(body["data"]) == 10

    def offset_and_window():
        c = Client()
        for i in range(15):
            c.post("/api/restaurants",
                   {"name": f"R{i:02d}", "address": "a", "lat": 0, "lng": 0},
                   role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        s, body = c.get("/api/restaurants?limit=5&offset=12",
                        role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert len(body["data"]) == 3
        assert body["meta"]["has_more"] is False

    def limit_out_of_range():
        c = Client()
        s, body = c.get("/api/restaurants?limit=0",
                        role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert s == 422 and body["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_VALIDATION"
        s, body = c.get("/api/restaurants?limit=101",
                        role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert s == 422

    def sort_by_created_at_ascending():
        c = Client()
        # creation order: A, B, C
        for n in ("A", "B", "C"):
            c.post("/api/restaurants",
                   {"name": n, "address": "a", "lat": 0, "lng": 0},
                   role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        s, body = c.get("/api/restaurants", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        names = [r["name"] for r in body["data"]]
        assert names == ["A", "B", "C"], names

    suite.case("default limit=10, offset=0, total_count, has_more", defaults_and_total)
    suite.case("offset windowing + has_more=false at tail", offset_and_window)
    suite.case("limit out of [1,100] -> ERR_VALIDATION", limit_out_of_range)
    suite.case("default sort by created_at ascending", sort_by_created_at_ascending)

"""OCC + concurrency-shaped failures."""
from .client import Client
from .fixtures import setup_basics, register_rider, place_order


def run(suite):
    def two_patches_same_version():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rid = ids["rid"]
        # first PATCH @ version=2 (after approve bumped to 2)
        s, body = c.patch(f"/api/restaurants/{rid}", {"address": "first", "version": 2},
                          role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert s == 200
        # second PATCH using stale version=2 -> conflict
        s, e = c.patch(f"/api/restaurants/{rid}", {"address": "second", "version": 2},
                       role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert s == 409 and e["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_VERSION_CONFLICT"

    def two_riders_accept_same_order():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        r1 = register_rider(c, phone="r-x")
        r2 = register_rider(c, phone="r-y")
        _, body = place_order(c, ids)
        oid = body["data"]["id"]
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/start-preparing", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        from app.server import store
        aid_first = next(a["id"] for a in store.assignments.values()
                         if a["order_id"] == oid and a["status"] == "OFFERED")
        # Dispatch a second offer manually
        s, body = c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/dispatch",
                         role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        if s != 201:
            return  # candidate pool exhausted; not the path under test
        aid_second = body["data"]["id"]
        # rider for second offer
        rider_second = body["data"]["rider_id"]
        rider_first = store.assignments[aid_first]["rider_id"]
        # First one accepts
        s, _ = c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid_first}/accept",
                      role="Rider", user_id=rider_first)
        assert s == 200
        # Second one tries to accept -> ERR_ORDER_ALREADY_ASSIGNED
        s, e = c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid_second}/accept",
                      role="Rider", user_id=rider_second)
        assert s == 409 and e["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_ORDER_ALREADY_ASSIGNED"

    suite.case("OCC: stale version PATCH -> ERR_VERSION_CONFLICT", two_patches_same_version)
    suite.case("two riders race to accept -> one wins, other ERR_ORDER_ALREADY_ASSIGNED",
               two_riders_accept_same_order)

"""Validation pipeline ordering (§2.6).

Priority:
 1. Auth headers
 2. Role-to-endpoint authorization
 3. Path-parameter existence (left-to-right)
 4. Body foreign-key existence
 5. Entity-identity match
 6. State-machine precondition
 7. Domain-specific safety checks (RESTAURANT_UNAVAILABLE, SUSPEND_CRITERIA_NOT_MET)
 8. Uniqueness invariants
 9. Temporal windows
10. Fiscal amount range
11. Body shape (ERR_VALIDATION / ERR_ORDER_INVALID)
12. OCC
13. Cross-entity gating (RELATED_RETURN_UNRESOLVED)
"""
from .client import Client
from .fixtures import setup_basics, register_rider, place_order


def run(suite):
    def auth_before_anything():
        # POST orders without headers — should yield ERR_AUTH_REQUIRED even though body is bogus.
        c = Client()
        s, body = c.post("/api/orders", {"items": "bogus"})
        assert s == 401 and body["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_AUTH_REQUIRED"

    def role_before_path_existence():
        # Customer tries POST /api/restaurants — even though body is missing, RBAC fires first
        c = Client()
        s, body = c.post("/api/restaurants", {}, role="Customer", user_id="x")
        assert s == 403 and body["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_FORBIDDEN"

    def path_left_to_right():
        # Unknown restaurant id in /api/restaurants/<rid>/menu-items
        c = Client()
        s, body = c.get("/api/restaurants/bogus/menu-items",
                        role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert s == 404 and body["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_NOT_FOUND"

    def body_fk_existence():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        # menu_item_id valid but customer_id bogus
        s, body = c.post("/api/orders", {
            "customer_id": "bogus", "restaurant_id": ids["rid"],
            "items": [{"menu_item_id": ids["mid"], "quantity": 1}],
        }, role="Customer", user_id="bogus")
        # customer_id is checked before role-identity, per pipeline step 4
        assert s == 404

    def identity_before_state_precondition():
        # A non-owner tries to accept an order
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        register_rider(c)
        _, body = place_order(c, ids)
        oid = body["data"]["id"]
        s, body = c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/accept",
                         role="Restaurant", user_id="wrong-restaurant")
        assert s == 403

    def state_before_domain_safety():
        # cancelling a delivered order: state machine should fire before any domain check
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider = register_rider(c)
        _, body = place_order(c, ids)
        oid = body["data"]["id"]
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/start-preparing", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        from app.server import store
        aid = next(a["id"] for a in store.assignments.values() if a["order_id"] == oid)
        c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/accept", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/ready", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/pickup", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
        c.post(f"/api/assignments/{aid}/deliver", role="Rider", user_id=rider)
        # Now try to cancel a DELIVERED order
        s, body = c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/cancel",
                         role="Customer", user_id=ids["cid"])
        assert s == 409 and body["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_INVALID_STATE"

    def occ_after_other_checks():
        # An invalid version is meaningless when role auth fails first.
        c = Client()
        s, body = c.patch("/api/restaurants/bogus", {"version": 1, "address": "a"},
                          role="Customer", user_id="x")
        # Customer not allowed to PATCH /api/restaurants/{id} -> ERR_FORBIDDEN before NOT_FOUND
        assert s == 403

    suite.case("auth fires before any body validation", auth_before_anything)
    suite.case("role auth before path existence", role_before_path_existence)
    suite.case("path id existence checked left-to-right", path_left_to_right)
    suite.case("body foreign-key existence before identity", body_fk_existence)
    suite.case("identity mismatch before state precondition", identity_before_state_precondition)
    suite.case("state precondition before domain check", state_before_domain_safety)
    suite.case("OCC only after other checks pass", occ_after_other_checks)

"""Clock advance + 60s offer-timeout sweep."""
from .client import Client
from .fixtures import setup_basics, register_rider, place_order


def run(suite):
    def advance_requires_admin():
        c = Client()
        s, _ = c.post("/api/_clock/advance", {"seconds": 1}, role="Customer", user_id="x")
        assert s == 403

    def offer_timeout_sweep():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider = register_rider(c)
        # Place + start-preparing -> assignment OFFERED
        _, body = place_order(c, ids)
        oid = body["data"]["id"]
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/start-preparing", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        from app.server import store
        aid = next(a["id"] for a in store.assignments.values()
                   if a["order_id"] == oid and a["status"] == "OFFERED")
        # Advance > 60s
        s, body = c.post("/api/_clock/advance", {"seconds": 61},
                         role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert s == 200
        assert body["data"]["swept_offers"] >= 1
        # The original assignment should be REJECTED
        s, a = c.get(f"/api/assignments/{aid}",
                     role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert a["data"]["status"] == "REJECTED"
        # A fresh offer should not exist because there's only one rider and they were the candidate
        # for this order. After their rejection, dispatch finds no candidate (same rider still excluded
        # only if it has a live assignment for this order; since the old one is REJECTED, they could
        # be re-offered). PRD says the system never re-offers an order to a rider who already holds it
        # — meaning "still holds" via OFFERED/ACCEPTED/PICKED_UP. REJECTED is not a live holding.
        # So a new OFFERED should exist targeting the same rider.
        new = [a for a in store.assignments.values()
               if a["order_id"] == oid and a["status"] == "OFFERED"]
        assert len(new) == 1

    def advance_below_60s_does_not_sweep():
        c, ids = setup_basics()
        rider = register_rider(c)
        _, body = place_order(c, ids)
        oid = body["data"]["id"]
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        c.post(f"/api/orders/{oid}/start-preparing", role="Restaurant", user_id=ids["rid"])
        s, body = c.post("/api/_clock/advance", {"seconds": 30},
                         role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="op")
        assert body["data"]["swept_offers"] == 0

    suite.case("/api/_clock/advance restricted to PlatformAdmin", advance_requires_admin)

"""Delivery cascade and fiscal reconciliation."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from ..auth import parse_headers, require_role
from ..clock import format_iso
from ..envelope import success
from ..errors import fail
from ..formulas import (
    delivery_fee_solo, commission_tiered, commission_override,
    merge_discount, late_fine_amount,
)
from ..resource import bump
from ..server import store, clock


def _parse_iso(s: str) -> datetime:
    if s.endswith("Z"):
        s = s[:-1] + "+00:00"
    return datetime.fromisoformat(s)


def deliver_assignment(aid):
    user_id, role = parse_headers()
    require_role("Rider")
    a = store.assignments.get(aid)
    if not a:
        raise fail("ERR_NOT_FOUND")
    if user_id != a["rider_id"]:
        raise fail("ERR_FORBIDDEN")
    if a["status"] != "PICKED_UP":
        raise fail("ERR_INVALID_STATE")
    o = store.orders[a["order_id"]]
    if o["status"] != "PICKED_UP":
        raise fail("ERR_INVALID_STATE")
    restaurant = store.restaurants[o["restaurant_id"]]
    rider = store.riders[a["rider_id"]]

    now = clock.now()
    now_iso = format_iso(now)
    a["status"] = "DELIVERED"
    a["delivered_at"] = now_iso
    o["status"] = "DELIVERED"
    o["actual_delivery_time"] = now_iso

    promised_dt = _parse_iso(o["promised_delivery_time"])
    diff_seconds = (now - promised_dt).total_seconds()
    if diff_seconds <= 0:
        minutes_late = 0
    else:
        minutes_late = int(diff_seconds // 60)
    o["minutes_late"] = minutes_late

    # Final delivery fee — reconciled from frozen inputs.
    solo_fee = delivery_fee_solo(o["distance_km"], o["is_peak"])
    rg = store.route_groups.get(a["route_group_id"]) if a["route_group_id"] else None
    if rg and len(rg["assignment_ids"]) >= 2:
        discount = merge_discount(solo_fee)
        final_fee = solo_fee - discount
    else:
        final_fee = solo_fee
    o["final_delivery_fee_cents"] = final_fee
    a["final_delivery_fee_cents"] = final_fee

    # Final commission — override at delivery time, or tiered.
    if restaurant["commission_rate_override"] is not None:
        final_comm = commission_override(o["subtotal_cents"], restaurant["commission_rate_override"])
    else:
        final_comm = commission_tiered(o["subtotal_cents"])
    o["final_commission_cents"] = final_comm

    # Payment captured.
    o["payment_status"] = "CAPTURED"

    bump(o)

    # Restaurant settlement increment.
    restaurant["pending_settlement_cents"] += o["subtotal_cents"] - final_comm
    bump(restaurant)

    # Rider wallet credit + on-time tracking + tier recompute.
    rider["wallet_balance_cents"] += final_fee
    rider["_recent_on_time"].append(minutes_late == 0)
    if len(rider["_recent_on_time"]) > 30:
        rider["_recent_on_time"] = rider["_recent_on_time"][-30:]
    rider["completed_deliveries"] += 1
    rider["on_time_rate"] = _on_time_rate(rider)
    _recompute_bonus_tier(rider)

    # Late fine cascade.
    if minutes_late > 0:
        amount = late_fine_amount(minutes_late, final_fee)
        from ..services.fines import create_fine
        # create_fine debits the rider wallet + bumps + recomputes tier as a sub-cascade
        create_fine("RIDER", rider["id"], "LATE_DELIVERY", amount)

    # If no other live assignments remain, return rider to AVAILABLE
    if not any(x for x in store.assignments.values()
               if x["rider_id"] == rider["id"] and x["status"] in ("OFFERED", "ACCEPTED", "PICKED_UP")
               and x["id"] != a["id"]):
        if rider["status"] == "ON_DELIVERY":
            rider["status"] = "AVAILABLE"
    bump(rider)

    # Route group completion check.
    if rg:
        all_done = all(store.assignments[aid_]["status"] == "DELIVERED" for aid_ in rg["assignment_ids"])
        if all_done:
            rg["status"] = "COMPLETED"

    return success(a)


def _on_time_rate(rider) -> float:
    vals = rider["_recent_on_time"]
    if len(vals) < 10:
        return 1.0
    return round(sum(1 for v in vals if v) / len(vals), 6)


def _recompute_bonus_tier(rider):
    from ..formulas import bonus_tier
    rider["bonus_tier"] = bonus_tier(rider["on_time_rate"], rider["acceptance_rate"], rider["rating"])

"""Fine creation + waive."""
from flask import g

from ..auth import parse_headers, require_role
from ..clock import format_iso
from ..envelope import success
from ..errors import fail
from ..ids import new_uuid
from ..resource import bump
from ..server import store, clock


def create_fine(subject_type: str, subject_id: str, reason: str, amount_cents: int) -> dict:
    """Create a fine and debit the appropriate ledger. Also re-evaluates rider bonus tier."""
    f = {
        "id": new_uuid(),
        "created_at": format_iso(clock.now()),
        "subject_type": subject_type,
        "subject_id": subject_id,
        "reason": reason,
        "amount_cents": amount_cents,
        "settlement_status": "PENDING",
    }
    store.fines[f["id"]] = f
    # Ledger side-effects per subject
    if subject_type == "RIDER":
        rider = store.riders.get(subject_id)
        if rider:
            rider["wallet_balance_cents"] -= amount_cents
            from ..formulas import bonus_tier
            rider["bonus_tier"] = bonus_tier(rider["on_time_rate"], rider["acceptance_rate"], rider["rating"])
            bump(rider)
    elif subject_type == "CUSTOMER":
        customer = store.customers.get(subject_id)
        if customer:
            # Debit the customer's credit balance by the fine amount, but not below zero.
            customer["credit_balance_cents"] = max(0, customer["credit_balance_cents"] - amount_cents)
            bump(customer)
    elif subject_type == "RESTAURANT":
        restaurant = store.restaurants.get(subject_id)
        if restaurant:
            restaurant["pending_settlement_cents"] -= amount_cents
            bump(restaurant)
    return f


def waive_fine(fid):
    parse_headers()
    require_role("CustomerService", "PlatformAdmin")
    f = store.fines.get(fid)
    if not f:
        raise fail("ERR_NOT_FOUND")
    if f["settlement_status"] != "PENDING":
        raise fail("ERR_INVALID_STATE")
    # Reverse ledger
    amount = f["amount_cents"]
    if f["subject_type"] == "RIDER":
        rider = store.riders.get(f["subject_id"])
        if rider:
            rider["wallet_balance_cents"] += amount
            from ..formulas import bonus_tier
            rider["bonus_tier"] = bonus_tier(rider["on_time_rate"], rider["acceptance_rate"], rider["rating"])
            bump(rider)
    elif f["subject_type"] == "CUSTOMER":
        customer = store.customers.get(f["subject_id"])
        if customer:
            customer["credit_balance_cents"] += amount
            bump(customer)
    elif f["subject_type"] == "RESTAURANT":
        restaurant = store.restaurants.get(f["subject_id"])
        if restaurant:
            restaurant["pending_settlement_cents"] += amount
            bump(restaurant)
    f["settlement_status"] = "WAIVED"
    return success(f)

    for r in store.returns.values():
        if r["order_id"] == oid and r["status"] in ("REQUESTED", "APPROVED", "ESCALATED"):
            raise fail("ERR_DUPLICATE_RETURN")
    if o["status"] not in ("DELIVERED",):
        raise fail("ERR_INVALID_STATE")
    # 24-hour window
    actual = _parse_iso(o["actual_delivery_time"])
    if (clock.now() - actual) > timedelta(hours=24):
        raise fail("ERR_RETURN_WINDOW_EXPIRED")
    body = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
    reason = body.get("reason")
    if reason not in REASONS:
        raise fail("ERR_VALIDATION", "reason invalid")
    requested = body.get("requested_refund_cents")
    if not isinstance(requested, int) or isinstance(requested, bool):
        raise fail("ERR_REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID")
    if requested < 1 or requested > o["subtotal_cents"]:
        raise fail("ERR_REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID")
    rec = stamp_new()
    rec.update({
        "order_id": oid,
        "reason": reason,
        "requested_refund_cents": requested,
        "approved_refund_cents": None,
        "reviewer_cs_user_id": None,
        "status": "REQUESTED",
    })
    store.returns[rec["id"]] = rec
    # Order cascade
    o["status"] = "REFUND_REQUESTED"
    bump(o)
    return success(rec, status=201)


def approve_return(rid):
    user_id, role = parse_headers()
    require_role("CustomerService")
    ret = store.returns.get(rid)
    if not ret:
        raise fail("ERR_NOT_FOUND")
    if ret["status"] not in ("REQUESTED", "ESCALATED"):
        raise fail("ERR_INVALID_STATE")
    o = store.orders[ret["order_id"]]
    body = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
    approved = body.get("approved_refund_cents")
    if not isinstance(approved, int) or isinstance(approved, bool):
        raise fail("ERR_REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID")
    if approved < 1 or approved > o["subtotal_cents"] or approved > ret["requested_refund_cents"]:
        raise fail("ERR_REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID")
    # Apply cascade
    ret["status"] = "APPROVED"
    ret["approved_refund_cents"] = approved
    ret["reviewer_cs_user_id"] = user_id
    bump(ret)
    # Order
    o["status"] = "REFUNDED"
    o["payment_status"] = "FULLY_REFUNDED" if approved == o["subtotal_cents"] else "PARTIALLY_REFUNDED"
    bump(o)
    # Customer credit
    customer = store.customers[o["customer_id"]]
    customer["credit_balance_cents"] += approved
    # Trust score: a successful return uses up some trust. PRD says it drops on abusive returns —
    # only fine creation drops the customer's trust on QUALITY_ISSUE + low trust; we keep this here
    # as a no-op for non-abusive returns.
    bump(customer)
    # Restaurant settlement decrement
    restaurant = store.restaurants[o["restaurant_id"]]
    restaurant["pending_settlement_cents"] -= approved
    bump(restaurant)
    # Abusive return fine
    if customer["trust_score"] < 0.5 and ret["reason"] == "QUALITY_ISSUE":
        from .fines import create_fine
        create_fine("CUSTOMER", customer["id"], "ABUSIVE_RETURN", approved)
    # Close any linked work order(s) that target this return — not specified, leave open.
    return success(ret)


def reject_return(rid):
    user_id, role = parse_headers()
    require_role("CustomerService")
    ret = store.returns.get(rid)
    if not ret:
        raise fail("ERR_NOT_FOUND")
    if ret["status"] not in ("REQUESTED", "ESCALATED"):
        raise fail("ERR_INVALID_STATE")
    ret["status"] = "REJECTED"
    ret["reviewer_cs_user_id"] = user_id
    bump(ret)
    # Order reverts from REFUND_REQUESTED to DELIVERED
    o = store.orders[ret["order_id"]]
    if o["status"] == "REFUND_REQUESTED":
        o["status"] = "DELIVERED"
        bump(o)
    return success(ret)


def escalate_return(rid):
    user_id, role = parse_headers()
    require_role("CustomerService")
    ret = store.returns.get(rid)
    if not ret:
        raise fail("ERR_NOT_FOUND")
    if ret["status"] != "REQUESTED":
        raise fail("ERR_INVALID_STATE")
    ret["status"] = "ESCALATED"
    bump(ret)
    # Open a linked WorkOrder
    from ..resource import stamp_new
    wo = stamp_new()
    wo.update({
        "opened_by_role": "CUSTOMER_SERVICE",
        "opened_by_id": user_id,
        "category": "OTHER",
        "related_order_id": ret["order_id"],
        "related_return_id": ret["id"],
        "status": "OPEN",
        "assigned_cs_user_id": None,
        "resolution_notes": None,
    })
    store.work_orders[wo["id"]] = wo
    return success(ret)


def reopen_return(rid):
    user_id, role = parse_headers()
    require_role("CustomerService")
    ret = store.returns.get(rid)
    if not ret:
        raise fail("ERR_NOT_FOUND")
    if ret["status"] != "ESCALATED":
        raise fail("ERR_INVALID_STATE")
    ret["status"] = "REQUESTED"
    bump(ret)
    # Close linked WorkOrder
    for wo in store.work_orders.values():
        if wo["related_return_id"] == ret["id"] and wo["status"] not in ("RESOLVED", "CLOSED"):
            wo["status"] = "CLOSED"
            bump(wo)
            break
    return success(ret)
